# EIA Lens

> EIA Lens is a free, browser-based tool that reviews Environmental Impact Assessments (EIA) and Environmental and Social Impact Assessments (ESIA). Upload a PDF and ten fixed, reproducible rules check the science; every red flag links to the page that proves it. The planner makes the decision. The PDF never leaves the user's device and no API key is needed.

## Pages

- [EIA Lens app](https://eialens.vercel.app/): upload an EIA/ESIA PDF or load the demo (West Container Terminal-1, Colombo Port, Sri Lanka, ESIA by ERM, 2023).
- [Source code and documentation](https://github.com/Anusara14/EIA-Lens): architecture, rules, limitations and test results.

## What it checks

- R1 Meteorological data covers at least one year
- R2 Dispersion setting (urban/rural) is justified
- R3 Model calibration or validation is reported
- R4 Sensitivity or uncertainty analysis is present
- R5 Climate change scenarios are considered
- R6 Baseline leaves at least 10% headroom below the limit
- R7 Averaging times match the standard
- R8 Text and tables agree
- R9 No placeholder or draft text remains
- R10 EMP commitments are SMART (owner, number, date or frequency, budget)

## Outputs

- Review-quality grades A–F (simplified Lee & Colley), model audit, auditability score, recommended decision (Approve / Approve with conditions / Revise)
- 3D map of the report's coordinates with optional Sentinel-2 turbidity overlay
- EMP promise ledger with SMART 0–4 scores; monitoring data against limits
- Printable A4 report

## Limits

- English, text-based PDFs; scanned PDFs need OCR first
- Rules are keyword/regex based; findings are decision support, not a decision

## Author

- Anusara14: https://github.com/Anusara14
